## Definition of Done

- [ ] Tests written first and seen failing; all tests now pass (output below)
- [ ] No test deleted, skipped, or weakened
- [ ] Simplest version that works — nothing speculative
- [ ] File header notes and doc comments added / still accurate
- [ ] Decisions logged (`05-decisions-log.md`), new terms in `11-glossary.md`
- [ ] Architecture diagrams updated if components, interfaces, flows, states, or stored data changed
- [ ] No non-functional requirement broken (`01-requirements.md` → NFRs)
- [ ] Security: no secrets added; new input validated; new dependencies verified and logged
- [ ] Accessibility checks pass for changed UI (`15-accessibility.md`) — or no UI change
- [ ] No new cost, or the cost decision is logged (`16-budget.md`)
- [ ] Story / bug status updated in `01-requirements.md`
- [ ] Session log entry written (`10-session-log.md`)
